name: github-platform-skills
description: Claude Code skills for working at the GitHub platform / organization level: well-architected guidance, rulesets, governance, scaling, migrations.

plugins.name: github-well-architected
plugins.description: Apply GitHub's Well-Architected Framework — prescriptive design thinking for deploying GitHub Enterprise at scale across five pillars (Productivity, Collaboration, Application Security, Governance, Architecture). Bundles curated guidance for repository rulesets, GHAS rollout, Copilot adoption, polyrepo vs monorepo, ADO migrations, and governance policies.

plugins.name: github-copilot-docs
plugins.description: GitHub's official Copilot documentation, bundled locally from github/docs. Covers plans and billing, AI credits and budgets, enterprise and org policies, models, content exclusion, MCP management, cloud agent, Copilot CLI, customization (instructions, agents, hooks), usage metrics, and rollout.
